title: Robust Receding Horizon Games with Additive Uncertainty
summary: We study a receding horizon game in which multiple agents drive linear systems subject to additive disturbances, private state and input constraints, and shared coupling constraints. We propose a robust game-theoretic control framework that combines tube-based constraint tightening with a finite-horizon generalized Nash equilibrium problem (GNEP), equipped with a discrete algebraic Riccati equation (DARE)-based terminal cost and a decoupled positively invariant terminal set.
